newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sime Singapore sees better year ahead.
newsitem.headline: Sime Singapore sees better year ahead.

text.p: Sime Singapore Ltd, a division of diversified Malaysian conglomerate Sime Darby Bhd said on Saturday it expected better results in the next financial year.
The company said earnings for the current financial year were depressed by losses in its motor dealership activities during the first half.

Its consumer services and packaging divisions were hit by a weak retail sector and fluctuations in raw material prices, but the engineering, heavy equipment and property divisions saw improved profits.
Sime Singapore reported a 59 percent drop in net profit to Singapore $12.7 million for the year ended June 30, 1996.
